topic.title: Deleting a Review Task
topic.shortdesc: How to permanently remove a review task when it is no longer needed.

body.p: Deleting a task permanently removes it from .
There are two ways to delete a task:

ul.li: Open the task Settings page and click Delete.
In the My Review Tasks page, hover over a task that you own and use the actions menu on the right side of the task entry to select Delete.

body.p: Result: The task is deleted from the server and removed from the tasks list.
